reason: ₹22,000 is more than I earn in a month, and we wash by hand at home without any trouble. Even ₹2,000 a month on EMI is a big cut from what we have for food and the farm, all for something we have never needed.
objection: A normal semi-automatic costs about half this, and I don't even own that. Why would I pay double for a battery when I don't have a machine at all?
would_change_my_mind: If it cost close to a basic semi-automatic, around ₹10,000 or EMI under ₹800 a month, and someone in the village I trust already used one without problems.
